selection_rule: Validation writer-verification ROC-AUC primary; canonical interpolated EER only as an exact-AUC tie-breaker.

control.description: Lambda-0 control reproducing the Notebook 14 SSL-initialized dynamic metric-learning writer encoder.

key_findings: Adversarial variants improved validation writer-verification utility.
The batch-level alternating variant produced the highest observed validation writer AUC.
Cross-script macro AUC improved for the best batch-level alternating variant.
Independent writer-disjoint linear probes continued to recover script with near-perfect ROC-AUC.
Low attached-adversary AUC was not evidence of script invariance because fresh independent probes recovered script almost perfectly.
scientific_interpretation: Under the evaluated single-seed QUWI validation protocol, script-adversarial training improved writer verification but did not demonstrate meaningful reduction of linearly accessible script information. The verification improvement therefore cannot currently be attributed to learned script invariance.
